titel: Why pineapple stops jelly from setting
kurz: With fresh pineapple, gelatine stays runny; with cooked pineapple, it sets.
bild_im_kopf: Like mice nibbling through a net: before it can set, it has already been cut to pieces.
beobachtung: Without pineapple and with tinned pineapple, the jelly sets. With fresh pineapple it stays runny, or only softens around the pieces.
erklaerung: Fresh pineapple contains an [[enzym|enzyme]] that cuts up protein. Gelatine is protein, so its network is taken apart before it can set. When pineapple is tinned, the fruit is heated, which switches the enzyme off.
sicherheit: Hot water for the jelly: adults do the heating.
schritte: Make the jelly as the packet says and divide it between three glasses.
Add pieces of fresh pineapple to the first glass, tinned pineapple to the second, and leave the third plain.
Put everything in the fridge for a few hours.
material: 1 packet of jelly, or gelatine with juice
